decision: Kept text-only keyless demo and explicit live mode
why: A user can test the workflow without microphone permission or paid keys; unavailable is never safe

decision: Bound sessions to token-derived seats and snapshot reconnect
why: Join may precede socket connection; a fresh authenticated snapshot restores peer state without trusting client speaker claims

decision: Cherry-picked backend, frontend, and delivery commits in order
why: Contract already existed; integrate only new lane commits

decision: Use exact 127.0.0.1 origin and configurable API_PORT for local browser checks
why: An unrelated service owns port 8000; WebSocket origin checks reject localhost when Vite serves 127.0.0.1
result: browser joins and signals on port 18080

decision: Ignore self peer broadcasts in each room view
why: The backend broadcasts each seat state to both sockets; self events otherwise overwrite the remote peer and prevent offers
result: peer test and browser reconnection pass

decision: Check actual inbound RTP and transcript evidence in two browser contexts
why: A remote media track alone does not prove inbound packets; evidence must point to a displayed segment
result: Chromium passed two tests; no paid provider call

decision: Keep deployment as a reverse-proxy reference without Docker
why: No Docker image or production proxy exists; current build produces frontend/dist but FastAPI does not serve it
result: local build verified; deployment not verified
